mapper.select: SELECT vendor_id AS vendorId, vendor_code AS vendorCode, vendor_name AS vendorName, contact_name AS contactName, phone, email, active, created_at AS createdAt FROM vendor ORDER BY vendor_id

SELECT vendor_id AS vendorId, vendor_code AS vendorCode, vendor_name AS vendorName, contact_name AS contactName, phone, email, address, active, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM vendor WHERE vendor_id = #{vendorId}

SELECT mr.request_id AS requestId, mr.production_plan_id AS productionPlanId, mr.department_id AS departmentId, d.department_name AS departmentName, mr.item_id AS itemId, i.item_code AS itemCode, i.item_name AS itemName, i.unit, mr.request_qty AS requestQty, mr.issued_qty AS issuedQty, (mr.request_qty - mr.issued_qty) AS shortageQty, mr.required_date AS requiredDate, mr.status, mr.requested_by AS requestedBy, u.user_name AS requestedByName, mr.created_at AS createdAt FROM material_request mr INNER JOIN item i ON i.item_id = mr.item_id INNER JOIN department d ON d.department_id = mr.department_id INNER JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = mr.requested_by WHERE mr.status = 'SHORTAGE' ORDER BY mr.required_date, mr.request_id

SELECT p.procurement_id AS procurementId, p.material_request_id AS materialRequestId, p.department_id AS departmentId, d.department_name AS departmentName, p.item_id AS itemId, i.item_code AS itemCode, i.item_name AS itemName, i.unit, p.request_qty AS requestQty, p.required_date AS requiredDate, p.quote_deadline AS quoteDeadline, p.selected_vendor_id AS selectedVendorId, v.vendor_name AS selectedVendorName, p.order_qty AS orderQty, p.unit_price AS unitPrice, p.received_qty AS receivedQty, p.status, p.created_by AS createdBy, u.user_name AS createdByName, p.created_at AS createdAt FROM procurement p INNER JOIN department d ON d.department_id = p.department_id INNER JOIN item i ON i.item_id = p.item_id INNER JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = p.created_by LEFT JOIN vendor v ON v.vendor_id = p.selected_vendor_id ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.procurement_id DESC

SELECT p.procurement_id AS procurementId, p.department_id AS departmentId, d.department_name AS departmentName,
p.material_request_id AS materialRequestId, mr.status AS materialRequestStatus, mr.request_qty AS materialRequestQty, mr.issued_qty AS materialRequestIssuedQty, mr.required_date AS materialRequestRequiredDate,
p.item_id AS itemId, i.item_code AS itemCode, i.item_name AS itemName, i.spec, i.unit,
p.request_qty AS requestQty, p.required_date AS requiredDate, p.quote_deadline AS quoteDeadline,
p.selected_vendor_id AS selectedVendorId, v.vendor_code AS selectedVendorCode, v.vendor_name AS selectedVendorName, v.contact_name AS selectedVendorContactName, v.phone AS selectedVendorPhone, v.email AS selectedVendorEmail,
p.order_qty AS orderQty, p.unit_price AS unitPrice, p.received_qty AS receivedQty, p.status, p.ordered_at AS orderedAt, p.shipped_at AS shippedAt, p.received_at AS receivedAt, p.inspection_result AS inspectionResult, p.terms,
p.created_by AS createdBy, u.user_name AS createdByName, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM procurement p INNER JOIN department d ON d.department_id = p.department_id INNER JOIN item i ON i.item_id = p.item_id INNER JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = p.created_by LEFT JOIN material_request mr ON mr.request_id = p.material_request_id LEFT JOIN vendor v ON v.vendor_id = p.selected_vendor_id WHERE p.procurement_id = #{procurementId}

SELECT q.quote_id AS quoteId, q.procurement_id AS procurementId, p.item_id AS itemId, i.item_code AS itemCode, i.item_name AS itemName, i.unit, p.request_qty AS requestQty, q.vendor_id AS vendorId, v.vendor_code AS vendorCode, v.vendor_name AS vendorName, q.status, q.unit_price AS unitPrice, q.delivery_date AS deliveryDate, q.terms, q.submitted_at AS submittedAt, q.created_at AS createdAt, q.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM vendor_quote q INNER JOIN procurement p ON p.procurement_id = q.procurement_id INNER JOIN item i ON i.item_id = p.item_id INNER JOIN vendor v ON v.vendor_id = q.vendor_id ORDER BY q.created_at DESC, q.quote_id DESC
